title: pleurothallis lindleyana
intro: Pleurothallis lindleyana, commonly known as the Lindley's Pleurothallis or Lindley's Pleurothallis Orchid, is a species of orchid in the family Orchidaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pleurothallis lindleyana include its ability to soothe and calm the body, as well as its potential to aid in the treatment of various health conditions. Bioactive constituents found in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, although further research is needed to fully understand its properties and effects.
